assertion_results.text: Data extraction identifies the ecosystem as RPM based on the library name (openssl-libs) and component context, not Cargo (Step 1 Ecosystem detection — read ecosystems from Ecosystem Mappings config)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 12: '| Ecosystem | RPM (system package) |' and line 31: 'Ecosystem: **RPM** (system package -- openssl-libs is an OS-level package)'. The ecosystem is correctly identified as RPM, not Cargo. Lock file is identified as rpms.lock.yaml (line 33).

assertion_results.text: Version impact table includes ALL versions from the 2.2.x stream supportability matrix (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) and uses rpms.lock.yaml data for version extraction (Step 2.3)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 8-12 contain a table with all five versions: 2.2.0 (v0.4.5, 3.0.7-25.el9_3), 2.2.1 (v0.4.8, 3.0.7-27.el9_4), 2.2.2 (v0.4.9, retag), 2.2.3 (v0.4.11, 3.0.7-28.el9_4), 2.2.4 (v0.4.12, 3.0.7-28.el9_4). The table column header is 'openssl-libs (rpms.lock.yaml)' explicitly showing rpms.lock.yaml as the data source.

assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 33-38: 'rpms.lock.yaml: PRESENT -> explicit install' and 'Origin: explicit install (openssl-libs specified in rpms.lock.yaml / rpms.in.yaml)'. Line 42: 'The rpms.lock.yaml classification (explicit install) is used as the sole determination of package origin.' Lock file presence is explicitly stated as the primary classification signal.

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md line 5: 'Case B: Affected -- create remediation task (system package / RPM ecosystem, 1 task).' Only one task description is provided, targeting 'rhtpa-release.0.4.z' (line 18). data-extraction.md line 35 confirms: 'Remediation tasks per stream: **1** (Konflux release repo fix only)'. No upstream backport task exists.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md contains all required sections: '## Repository' (line 16), '## Target Branch' (line 20), '## Description' (line 24), '## Implementation Notes' (line 40), '## Acceptance Criteria' (line 59). No '## Files to Modify' section exists anywhere in the task description, confirming intentional omission.

assertion_results.text: The version impact output addresses SBOM verification in the dependency chain context — either noting that verification was skipped because cosign is not available or because external tools are prohibited, or presenting the SBOM classification result (Step 2.3.5 Optional SBOM verification)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md line 34: 'SBOM verification: skipped -- cosign not available. Using rpms.lock.yaml classification only.' Lines 42-43: 'SBOM verification status: Skipped. cosign is not available in this environment, so SBOM comparison between the final container image and base image could not be performed.' The output explicitly addresses SBOM verification and explains why it was skipped.
